anolisa.architecture: ANOLISA distribution CLI, installation, platform and component integration
anolisa.notes: Trace CLI dispatch into core, build and platform crates and the selected component manifest. Check supported installation mode and platform.

cosh.notes: Analyze the retained TypeScript implementation and archived contracts. Deprecation alone does not assign P3. Do not confuse this component with cosh-ng.

cosh-ng.architecture: Rust Cosh NG shell and gateway
cosh-ng.notes: Trace the reported shell or gateway entrypoint into the relevant crate. Check Linux versus limited macOS behavior and the actual execution mode.

sec-core.notes: Trace V2 entrypoints and shared dependencies. Source-confirmed legacy V1-only active reports use v1_only, not_applicable, no claims, and P3 backlog classification. Establish the version boundary with source evidence; do not verify the V1 defect. Unknown version scope remains unresolved.

skill.architecture: OS Skills definitions and bundled scripts
skill.notes: Identify the reported skill's SKILL.md, bundled scripts and declared tool prerequisites. Distinguish skill instructions from executable implementation and trace any external dependency explicitly.

sight.notes: Identify the collector or viewer entrypoint and its supported platform. Trace eBPF and trajectory paths separately and check privilege, kernel and storage prerequisites.

tokenless.architecture: Tokenless CLI, compression runtime and framework adapters
tokenless.notes: Identify the CLI or adapter entrypoint, compression mode and platform. Trace runtime and protocol contracts; distinguish savings metrics from supported correctness effects.

ckpt.architecture: Workspace checkpoint CLI, daemon and plugins
ckpt.notes: Trace the reported CLI or plugin into daemon and common contracts. Establish checkpoint, filesystem and restore prerequisites before assessing data effects.

memory.architecture: Agent Memory CLI, MCP and filesystem-backed storage
memory.notes: Trace the reported CLI or MCP operation into storage and mount behavior. Check namespace, cgroup, ownership and persistence contracts where relevant.

skillfs.architecture: SkillFS CLI, FUSE and core contracts
skillfs.notes: Identify FUSE operation, mount mode and security configuration. Trace core, resolver, notification and daemon boundaries only where reachable.

ktuner.notes: Trace CLI options into the tuning action and its Linux prerequisites. Incubating status alone does not lower priority.

aw.architecture: AW CLI, services, packages and provider contracts
aw.notes: Trace the selected CLI mode into its owning framework crate. Distinguish software installation, Hook connection and provider contracts. Read scoped AW instructions.

benchmark.architecture: Benchmark runners, workloads and evaluation contracts
benchmark.notes: Identify the reported runner, workload, metric and comparison baseline. Trace its implementation and evaluation contract. Do not infer product runtime impact from a benchmark discrepancy alone.
